---
pagetitle: "ES decision trees: sensitivity and pinch points"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    mathjax: null
    self_contained: true
---

```{r run-analysis, include = FALSE}
# Runs the full framework each time Posit Connect renders this document:
# validation tests -> sensitivity analysis -> report HTML.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# 1. Validation tests: stop the render if the editable models no longer
#    match the original script code.
#    (test_that() run outside a test runner stops with an error on failure)
source("tests/test_all.R", local = new.env())

# 2. Full analysis: writes outputs/ (CSVs, plots, results.json) and
#    builds report/es_sensitivity_report.html
source("run_all.R", local = new.env())

# 3. Pull the styles and body out of the built report for embedding
page <- rawToChar(readBin("report/es_sensitivity_report.html", "raw",
                          file.info("report/es_sensitivity_report.html")$size))
Encoding(page) <- "UTF-8"
style <- regmatches(page, regexpr("<style>[\\s\\S]*?</style>", page, perl = TRUE))
# (Google Fonts link left out so rendering needs no internet access; falls back to system fonts)
body  <- sub("(?s).*<body>(.*)</body>.*", "\\1", page, perl = TRUE)
```

```{r report, results = "asis"}
cat(style, body, sep = "\n")
```
